trailer.subtitle: A preview
trailer.title: Our trailer
trailer.description: Before the big day, we'd love to share a little glimpse of what awaits us. A short trailer that tells a special moment of our story and opens the door to the most beautiful chapter yet.

story.afterDate: in Chieri, the place where we had already promised ourselves to one another during a simple and intimate civil ceremony. The next step, however, is the one we have always dreamed of sharing with you. On September 4th we will celebrate our union surrounded by the people who have made our journey so special. This is only the trailer... the best movie is yet to begin!

fragments.title: Memories we have shared
fragments.description: Our story began 7 years ago, almost by chance, through encounters, conversations and small moments that soon became important. Since then, we have shared journeys, plans and dreams.

ceremony.title: Ceremony
ceremony.description: Welcoming of the guests and beginning of the ceremony.

party.title: Party
party.description: Music, dancing and celebrations until late.

description.beforeLink: Catania Airport is the main arrival point for guests travelling to Sicily by plane. From there, you can rent a car or take an
description.afterLink: bus, which provides frequent connections between Catania and Ragusa throughout the day.

description.beforeFaq: For guests who would like to stay overnight, the Relais has a limited number of rooms available (
description.afterFaq: ). Alternatively, Ragusa and the surrounding area offer a wide range of hotels, B&Bs and holiday homes.

description.beforeLink: We have created a WhatsApp group for everyone attending the wedding. It will be a place to get to know one another, stay in touch and share useful information before the celebration.

donation.subtitle: A new chapter
donation.title: The most beautiful gift
donation.description: More than material gifts, we dream of experiences. The most beautiful gift would be the opportunity to continue discovering the world together, collecting memories that will stay with us for a lifetime. Should you wish to give us a gift, you can contribute to our journey while also supporting a cause that is especially close to our hearts.

travel.label: Honeymoon
travel.title: Our next journey
travel.description: Travelling is one of the things we love most. Every destination gives us something new, and every departure becomes a memory to cherish. By contributing, you will help us experience a new adventure together.

charity.label: Charity
charity.title: A gesture that goes beyond us
charity.description: We believe that a joyful occasion can also become an opportunity to do good. For this reason, part of the gifts we receive will be donated to an organization that works every day to help those who need it most.
charity.organizationDescription: A brief description of the organization's mission. You can replace this text once you have chosen the project you would like to support.

arrival.question: What time should I arrive?
arrival.answer: We recommend arriving at least 30 minutes before the ceremony begins. Arriving early will give you the chance to meet other guests and enjoy a welcome drink (on us).

location.question: Will the ceremony and reception take place at the same venue?
location.answer: Yes! The entire day will take place at Relais Chiaramonte - Sala Qirat. The ceremony is planned outdoors, but in case of bad weather, costumes and life jackets will be available.

dressCode.question: Is there a dress code?
dressCode.intro: Yes, the dress code is elegant. Since part of the event takes place outdoors, we recommend wearing comfortable shoes.

men.label: For gentlemen
men.text: Besides your formal wedding tie, bring a second one and get creative! The bride-team will vote for the 'ugliest' tie, and the winner will receive a special prize.

children.question: Are children welcome?
children.answer: No, Giorgio doesn't like children... just kidding! We'd love to have them with us. Please remember to include them in your RSVP.

rsvpMeaning.question: What does RSVP mean?
rsvpMeaning.answer: It stands for the French expression "Répondez s'il vous plaît", which is simply a fancy way of asking: "Will you be there?"

allergies.question: Can I let you know about allergies or dietary requirements?
allergies.answer: Absolutely. When confirming your attendance, you'll be able to let us know about allergies, intolerances or any dietary requirements. We'll do our best to accommodate everyone.

accommodation.question: Is it possible to stay overnight at the venue?

answer.beforeEmail: Yes. The Relais has a limited number of rooms available. If you would like to stay overnight, we recommend booking as early as possible through Booking, the official website, or by emailing
answer.afterEmail: , making sure to mention that you will be attending our wedding so you can benefit from the special rate reserved for our guests.

parking.question: Is parking available?
parking.answer: The best way to arrive would be by helicopter... but yes! The venue is about 15 minutes from Ragusa and offers a large complimentary parking area reserved for guests.

confirmation.question: When should I confirm my attendance?
confirmation.answer: You're already late. Please confirm your attendance by the date indicated on the website, otherwise the chef might stop talking to us.

modify.question: Can I change my RSVP after submitting it?
modify.answer: Yes. If your plans change or you need to update the information you've already provided, simply get in touch with us.

answer.beforeLink: During the ceremony, we'd love for you to put your phone away and simply enjoy the moment with us. Our photographers and videographers will capture every memory, so relax and be fully present. After the ceremony, feel free to take as many photos and videos as you'd like and, if you wish, you can share them
